extraction.title: Free Exchange
extraction.subtitle: Has the World Bank performed a U-turn on industrial policy? Interventionists who think so should read its new report more closely
extraction.summary: The World Bank's new report, 'Industrial Policy for Development', suggests a shift towards endorsing government intervention in industrial policy, challenging the long-held Washington Consensus. While it acknowledges the need for public inputs like infrastructure, it remains cautious about market incentives, warning against the risks of interventionism.
